localChanges: You can now play without importing anything: civ.one's own pixel art draws the map, the units, the cities, the city screen, the reports and the cursor, so New Game, Load Game and Continue no longer wait for an import. Importing Civilization's art is now an upgrade, and a player who has imported it sees the game as before (#1063).
In Art and sound, each map art set has Use for square maps (or its grid), to choose which art that map is drawn with, and each theme says whose art it draws with now (#1063).
Civilization's music and Civilization II's art can be imported without importing Civilization's art first (#1063).
A game saved on a square map loads with the pixel art when Civilization's art isn't imported (#1063).
On a first visit offline with nothing imported, the menu says why it can't offer a game, instead of leaving it out silently (#1063).
